Resolves #21474

🌿 *The markdown page can no longer open on four buttons and nothing else.*

More components gets its second card and two more tiles. The markdown page opens streaming its document, and its cover is where the stream ends: the code, the table under its head, and a script tag and a `javascript:` link rendered as plain text. Process tells a trip in four English stages and opens horizontal; the splitter's panels hold folders and an inbox; both are tiles now. The four MWC wrappers and the German real-world form leave the catalog, as #21142 decided; their folders stay.

**Merge order:** #21478 (the streaming parser), #21458 and neomjs/pages#133 (the covers) are merged, so the cherry-picks this branch carried arrive from `dev`. Ada's #21486 makes the catalog specs derive their counts; once it lands, this branch takes one last merge on those two specs.

Evidence: L3 (catalog, capture and markdown specs; the catalog e2e; two capture runs per cover with the same bytes; frames at 1440 and 390) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

- The process example opens horizontal: cropped to a tile, the vertical process showed one stage.
- At 390 px the markdown toolbar ran its last two buttons off the screen: the toolbar wraps.
- The splitter's border, width cap and pane padding, and the trip log's container and heading, take their styles from their stylesheets. Below 600px the splitter's panes stay inside the stage and each scrolls its text, and the trip log's heading shrinks so the first stage shows. At desktop widths both render as before.
- Opening the markdown page streaming exposed #21477: the stream cut two headings and lost the table's head. The fix is its own PR, #21478, merged.

## Cold look

Two readers without this session's context graded the unlabelled pairs from 1 to 10 (how well a newcomer understands within ten seconds what the page shows and what to do), the second reader with the order swapped:

| Released → changed | Reader 1 (released shown first) | Reader 2 (changed shown first) |
|---|---|---|
| More components, 1440 | 7 → 7 | 7 → 6 |
| Splitter, 390 | 3 → 8 | 4 → 8 |
| Process, 390 | 4 → 6 | 4 → 6 |

Both read the changed splitter as a split pane whose own text says to drag the bar, and the released one as two blank panes. Both read "Trip log" and "Departure" as a trip timeline where the released page showed a bare "Configurable" heading. Neither found the group page clearer. Both read the markdown card's cover as a document clipped mid-way, with text showing through its caption bar. The cover is taken where the stream ends, and the caption overlay sits on running text. That is the open finding of this cold look: the cover needs a region whose bottom edge is calm under the caption.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] Once this PR is merged, the Portal's More components page shows two cards and ten tiles, each with its cover.
